FN-YFPC6N6-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 175
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/04/2024
Senate Bill 175 as introduced would increase the obligations of those local boards of education
whose board members monthly compensation is currently equal to $600 per month that vote to
increase board member compensation up to the $900 per month cap, authorized pursuant to the
provisions of this bill. The increased costs for those local boards would depend upon: (1) the
amount of the increase from $600 to $900 per month approved by the board; (2) the number of
board members affected; and (3) the number of board members, if any, that refuse to accept all
or any portion of the increased compensation.
This bill would also (1) prohibit a member of a local board of education not in compliance with
continuing education and training requirements from receiving compensation, until the member
is in compliance; and (2) require all compensation not received by a board member for
noncompliance to remain in escrow, until the member becomes compliant or to revert back to
the local boards of education once the individual is no longer a member of the board.

FN-YFPC6N6-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 175
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 175 as passed the Senate could increase the obligations of any local board of
education that votes to increase board member compensation above $600 per month, under
current law, to no more than $900 per month as authorized pursuant to the provisions of this
bill, by an undetermined amount dependent on: (1) the compensation increase from $600 to
$900 per month as approved by the board; and (2) the number of board members affected.
This bill would also: (1) prohibit a member of a local board of education not in compliance with
continuing education and training requirements from receiving compensation, until the member
is in compliance; and (2) require all compensation not received by a board member for
noncompliance to remain in escrow until the member becomes compliant, or to revert back to
the local board of education once the individual is no longer a member of the
board.
